page.notes: The reading of the final catchword "tem" is uncertain. Italic and roman type were judged from the scan and may be imperfect in places, especially in the Sextæ paragraph. The stroke near the right margin at mid-page is a mark, not text, and was left out. The note "Mat. 26. 26." and "28." are printed on two lines and are given as two notes.
